result_text:
I changed `StockStore.listInWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockStore.java` so the warehouse stock list no longer shows products with nothing left. Its query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, and I updated the Javadoc to say so. The list is still ordered by product name, then id.

`findQuantity` is untouched, so asking for the quantity of nuts in WH-1 still returns 0.

The full `mvn -q -o test` run finished with no output, which I read as all tests passing. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case. I haven't committed anything.
